name: background/light-theme
reason: pending: VERIFIED in this file, and the clearest case for why the dark value cannot be guessed. Bound by Next actions modal (30115:781), Configuration (13717:37944), Radio tile (26746:17352) and Radio card (30573:16933). Figma reports its LIGHT value as #fcf4f7 — identical to Background/Theme, which is @Base colours/Pale Pink Theme (#fcf4f7) in light and #2c3844 in dark. So swapping Background/Theme for Background/Light theme changes NOTHING in light mode; the whole point of the change must be in dark, where Background/Theme goes dark slate. Recording it as Background/Theme would look right in every light-mode screenshot and be wrong in dark, which is the exact failure the semantic-token rule exists to prevent
